facts.fact: NITA-U is stated to run a national Tier 3 cloud data centre in Kampala and Jinja that hosts 57 government institutions and centrally hosts government applications and data, launched 2019-07-11.

systems.platform: Tier 3 data centre, Kampala and Jinja

note: Data centre was put together by contractor Sybyl Limited, so no in-house build fact.
